In return we will accept a two‑year standstill on initiating new antidumping/countervailing proceedings in those annexed lines, provided credible, operational emergency safeguards are preserved: jointly‑certified surge triggers (for example >25% year‑on‑year import growth or agreed absolute volume thresholds), a 21‑day consultation window, and WTO‑consistent provisional measures capped at six months pending review.  
To protect predictability while addressing real injury risks, the package must include a mandatory, objective mid‑term review at 12 months with pre‑specified indicators and procedures that permit proportional, narrowly‑targeted adjustments only if clearly demonstrated thresholds are met.  
We will table clean legal text and the annex listing the exact HS codes and quantitative trigger values to the secretariat within 90 minutes; please provide your written confirmation within two hours so drafting can commence and business disruption is minimised.
